Elimyssalo on Suomen itärajaan rajoittuva valtion luonnonsuojelualue Kuhmossa, Kainuussa. Se on pinta-alaltaan Kainuun laajin luonnonsuojelualue, 82 neliökilometriä. Alue on luonnoltaan monipuolista ja edustavaa. Siellä on runsaasti erilaisia luontotyyppejä. Maisema on moni-ilmeinen. Metsät ovat hakkaamattomia aarnimetsiä. Salon ydinalue on Elimysjärven ympäristö. Elimyssalo on aarnimetsien, monenlaisten soiden, vaarojen, naavaisten korpikuusikoiden ja rehevien puronvarsien sekä pienien järvien ja lampien mosaiikkimainen kokonaisuus. Soiden osuus pinta-alasta on merkittävä. Suometsiä ja korpia on runsaasti. Roninsuo on Kainuun komeimpia rimpi- ja kalvakkanevoja. Hyvin suuri osa Keski- ja Itä-Kainuun yli 150- ja 200-vuotiaista metsistä sijaitsee Elimyssalossa. Vanhoja aihkimäntyjä sekä on siellä täällä ja keloja näkyy paljon varsinkin soiden reunamilla. Metsät ovat naavaisia. Myös harvinaista raidankeuhkojäkälää esiintyy alueella. Retkeilyreittejä alueella on yhteensä 24 kilometriä. Lappajärvi is the largest Crater Lake in Europe, created by a asteroid 78 million years ago.
Impact Crater Lake Lappajärvi Geopark is situated around the Europe's biggest impact crater lake. The area has had a UNESCO Global Geopark status since 2024. Nature, unique geological history and Alvar Aalto sites invites you to explore more.
Impact Crater Lake Lappajärvi  Geopark is a regional area, situated around the Europe's biggest impact crater lake Lappajärvi and the 4 municipalities around the lake in Southern Ostrobothnia in Finland.  Our Geopark is a treasure of Western Finland known for its beautiful landscapes, idyllic towns and distinctive villages and brings together scenery nature sites, charming hiking trails and historic cultural sites, all of which are well worth experiencing when visiting Western Finland.
Through unique sites and charming landscapes, Impact Crater Lake Geopark tells the story of the birth of Europe’s largest crater lake in a intriguing way. We have lots of sights to visit -  and most of our sights are always open since they are outdoors in the beautiful nature.

hides

Myös Soininharjun jatkona oleva Niiniharju on yli 180 metriä korkea. Alueen harjut ja harjukuopat eli supat kuuluvat harjujensuojeluohjelmaan. Rokua UNESCO Global Geopark - Rokua Geopark Rokua Geopark See and experience Learn Services Articles FI EN NL DE search See and experience Routes Cultural attractions Nature attractions Activities Environmental Art Services Accommodation Event and activity services Equipment rental Restaurants Groups Search for services Articles Pet-friendly services Educational Travel and Study Trips at Rokua UNESCO Global Geopark Humanpolis Responsibility Investing and working in the Rokua Geopark area Services for entrepreneurs For Professionals Contact Learn Stories Hiking information service of Finnish forest administration (Metsähallitus) for Rokua National Park and Manamansalo Hiking Area luontoon.fi Contact Finnish Geoparks Pohjola Route Humanpolis Oy Valtatie 17 91500 Muhos, Finland info@rokuageopark.fi Facebook Instagram YouTube Rokua Geopark Welcome to discover the traces of the last Ice Age With its charming nature trails and unique geology, Rokua Geopark is Finland's first UNESCO Global Geopark. Take a journey through landscapes shaped by the Ice Age and discover sites that tell the story of the region's origins from the Ice Age to the present day! Find your trip Arrival Geopark in the middle of Finland Rokua Geopark is located in Northern Ostrobothnia in the municipalities of Muhos, Utajärvi and Vaala. Coming from Oulu, the area begins in Muhos, about 20 km from the city, and continues to Lake Oulujärvi, about 90 km away. You can get to Rokua by public transport, car, bicycle, hiking or even by boat! Directions to Rokua Geopark THE STORY Finland’s first UNESCO Global Geopark takes you to the traces of the Ice Age Rokua Geopark is the first travel destination in Finland to be awarded UNESCO Global Geopark status. It is one of the northernmost of the almost 200 UNESCO Global Geoparks in the world. Read more about Geopark Right now Summer Rokua Geopark summer experiences There are many ways to enjoy the summer sunshine in Rokua Geopark. Here are some tips for a day trip or a short holiday! Hiking Activities Put on your backpack and go! The hiking trails in Rokua Geopark are set in a unique environment. On your hike, you will experience ridge landscapes with lichens and clear-water ponds, deep river valleys with groves and rocky outcrops, and wide, sun-drenched lake shores. Read more about round trips Mountain biking Activities The most extensive official mountain bike trails in the Rokua Geopark area can be found in Rokua National Park. There are also combined hiking and mountain biking trails in Manamansalo on Lake Oulujärvi and in the Oulujoki Valley Tar Routes. You can bike on your own or take a guided tour. Mountain biking Canoeing Activities A canoe trip is a great way to discover the nature of Rokua Geopark from a different perspective! Canoeing is a form of exercise similar to hiking where you can train your arms and core muscles and refresh your mind with the breathtaking scenery. Canoeing can be done in a kayak or an open canoe. There are a number of companies in the area that can provide canoeing instruction, information and equipment rental. You can contact them to book equipment already when you are planning your trip. Canoeing Fishing Activities The wilderness areas of Rokua Geopark have rich fishing waters. The waters in the area - the Oulujoki River, Lake Oulujäri and a number of smaller lakes and ponds - contain pike, pike-perch, rainbow trout and lake trout. All the waterways in the area have easily accessible and peaceful fishing waters with good accommodation and other facilities for longer fishing trips. Winter fishing is good on the smaller lakes and ponds in the area. Fishing

generation_excerpts: Vaskijärvi Strict Nature Reserve with its surroundings is one of the largest areas in Southwestern Finlands which still are wilderness-like. Located next to Kurjenrahka National Park, the nature reserve is usually characterized by almost unbroken tranquility, with only the Cranes shouting and Dragonflies buzzing.
